composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the tile centered and filling about 70% of the square with even margins (at least 14% on every side). It is ONE single small diorama tile that will be placed inside an open lunch box, so it must read as one compact object on its own little round base, not as a room. The sheet of paper is BLANK: evenly spaced ruled lines only, absolutely no writing, no characters, no letters, no numbers, no scribbles that could read as text. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the tile floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only within the tile. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: handwriting, scribbles or any marks on the paper other than blank ruled lines
attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
walls, room or floor around the tile
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the tile
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the tile.
purpose: 給食 WORLD MAP の「こんだてをかんがえる」タイル。弁当箱の中に置かれる小さな計画机のジオラマ 1 個
scene: a miniature planning-desk tile as a single diorama piece, built on a small round clay base exactly like the round base under the approved school building: one small warm wooden desk with a single sheet of pale cream paper lying flat on it showing only evenly spaced blank ruled lines (no writing at all), and one short pencil lying beside the paper on the desk. Same matte clay / miniature toy material, same lighting and same warm palette as the school tile and the dish set. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
required_objects: one sheet of paper with blank ruled lines and no writing
one pencil lying on the desk
one small round clay base under the whole tile
